ledger: Smartphone center display (main clock area): reads as a deformed 'a742' at 00:01-00:02, sharpens and morphs into 'Ā7·42' (an 'A' with an overline before '7·42') from 00:03 to 00:08, and smears into vertical strokes at 00:09.
Smartphone top-left status bar: blurry until 00:04, then reads '7.42' next to a green rectangular icon from 00:04 to 00:08.
Smartphone top-center text: reads '4:41' at the top edge with 'A 7' directly beneath it at 00:03; from 00:04 to 00:08 the lower text reads 'A Ā' / 'A·Ā' with a floating horizontal bar.
Smartphone bottom-center text: emerges at 00:04 reading 'AZ - 12', fades into glare at 00:05-00:06, and reads '12' stacked above 'AZ - 12' at 00:07-00:08.

findings.description: The smartphone lock screen displays nonsensical, self-contradictory pseudo-text where a readable clock and UI should be: the main clock reads 'Ā7·42' (mixing a letter with a macron and digits), accompanied by conflicting status bar times ('7.42' on the left and '4:41' in the center) and gibberish labels ('A Ā' and 'AZ - 12').

Text elements on the phone screen mutate without any screen interaction: the first glyph of the main center text changes from a curved 'a'/'3' shape at 00:01-00:02 to a sharp 'Ā' by 00:04, the top-center sub-header changes from 'A 7' at 00:03 to 'A Ā' at 00:04, and an extra '12' appears above 'AZ - 12' at 00:07 after a shadow passes over the screen.
